comment: Not many assignments but easy readings. He holds interesting lectures and throws in a few jokes here and there. He is quite knowledgeable and passionate about global politics and isn't tough when grading papers (only about 2 short papers in a semester).

He's a really goofy guy, which kept the lectures engaging. But it's a 100% lecture class, and it's tempting to zone out on his tangents. At times he can get weirdly snappy or impatient when you ask for help on papers and such. There's a solid amount of reading, but besides that the workload is very manageable.

Dr. Reda is the best teacher Ive had this semester! Hes kind, funny, and his lectures are really easy to pay attention to. If you listen to his instructions and put some work in, you can easily get an A. Seriously, take his class.
Dr. Reda is such an awesome dude. Office hours were super helpful and he was just always an easy person to talk to. The workload is really manageable and he's a very fair grader. Take his class!

What an approachable professor! Dr. Reda's lectures are interesting and engaging, and he's super chill in class. Be prepared for long readings, but it's all fascinating and super doable--also, he likes to give "pop" quizzes, but there's extra credit, and as long as you read the textbook and articles, they're no problem. Highly recommend!

Dr. Reda is a knowledgable professor, but his lectures are rather boring. Most of what he discusses is recapping the previous night's readings, so class isn't very engaging. If you're taking his class for credit, it isn't difficult to do well. But if you're passionate about the subject and looking for thought provoking discussion, look elsewhere
Makes class fun and he is really understanding and helpful.

Molla is a professor that genuinely wants his students to do well and is accessible in office hours outside of class. The readings are interesting and you learn a lot through his class, but it was also generally easygoing because of his clear grading criteria.

He has a perfect balance of wit and professionalism. He is pretty chill and creates a conducive environment for discussions and humor in class. His lectures are very clear and if you are attentive in class, it's easy to get a good grade. He knows what he is talking about and it is entertaining hearing him rant esp about stupidity in IP. Love him!
